facts.claim: EUI publishes responsive layout, form validation, table, panel, callout, token, and pattern guidance in one component framework.
EUI flex groups serve single-row alignment, flex grids serve repeated wrapping rows, and semantic output elements can replace default div elements.
EUI's opinionated table components include mobile row behavior, row actions, expansion, sorting, pagination, and search according to the selected component.
EUI warns that custom table building blocks transfer data management, accessibility, and mobile behavior to the implementer.
EUI keeps semantic token keys stable across color modes and requires state meaning to use icons or copy in addition to color.
Use EUI only to test whether the library's dense search, filter, comparison, and download controls expose complete mobile and accessibility behavior.

dimension_boundary: Dimension findings are project synthesis. Source facts remain classified above, target prescriptions are recommended, and insufficient source evidence is marked unknown.

composition.finding: Repeated results and compact controls can use flexible rows and wrapping grids, but the target should keep its own semantic HTML and layout system.

typography.finding: The inspected sources establish text and title components but do not provide enough current type-system evidence for a transferable typography rule.

color.finding: State and action colors must retain semantic roles across modes and never carry meaning alone.

density.finding: Compact table and filter density is useful only when search, sorting, actions, mobile behavior, and state meaning remain legible.

imagery.finding: No transferable imagery system was established from the inspected EUI framework pages.

motion.finding: No consequential motion rule was established from the inspected EUI sources.

interaction.finding: Table behavior must specify mobile selection, actions, expansion, sorting, pagination, search, and keyboard semantics instead of relying on visual rows alone.

hierarchy.finding: Controls stay close to the data they change, while flexible layout primitives preserve section and content order.

surfaces.finding: Panels and callouts may separate data or state, but the target should add a surface only when it names a functional region.

essential_traits: Dense data controls with complete behavior
Opinionated mobile behavior for complex tables
Semantic color roles with non-color state cues
Composable layout primitives that preserve semantic output
incidental_traits: Elastic's literal blue, teal, pink, and gray scales
EUI component names and React APIs

role_invariants.source_role: Semantic tokens assign action and status meaning while icons or copy provide redundant cues.
role_invariants.target_role: Original action and status colors pair with labels, icons, or text in filters, downloads, and evidence states.
role_invariants.reason: Semantic redundancy is useful; Elastic's values are not.

role_invariants.source_role: The inspected control and table sources do not depend on decorative media.
role_invariants.target_role: Keep operational catalog and download controls free of decorative imagery.
role_invariants.reason: Data interaction should remain the visual focus.

role_invariants.source_role: Dense tables remain usable through explicit search, sort, pagination, selection, actions, and mobile behavior.
role_invariants.target_role: Compact catalog and structured-data views expose the same behavioral completeness.
role_invariants.reason: This is EUI's narrow contribution to the target.

role_invariants.source_role: Opinionated components carry behavior; custom primitives transfer responsibility to the implementer.
role_invariants.target_role: Custom components must document and test every behavior that a library would otherwise supply.
role_invariants.reason: The responsibility boundary prevents incomplete custom controls.

misuse_risks: Copying EUI colors or component shapes instead of its behavior completeness.
Building visually dense rows without mobile, keyboard, empty, loading, and failure states.
Treating color as the only status signal.
Importing a framework when the approved target needs only the transferable behavior.
evidence_limitations: No target runtime was tested against EUI components.
Typography, imagery, and motion were not sufficiently evidenced for transfer.
Owner framework claims do not establish target conformance.
